items.title: A large scale multicentre randomized, placebo-controlled subcutaneous house dust mite allergen immunotherapy (HDM SCIT) in allergic rhinitis: MITAR Study.
items.journal: Asian Pacific journal of allergy and immunology
items.summary: Large multicentre RCT of house dust mite subcutaneous immunotherapy in moderate-to-severe allergic rhinitis patients already on intranasal corticosteroids.

items.title: The Effect of Levagen+ (Palmitoylethanolamide) Supplementation on Symptoms of Allergic Rhinitis-A Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: Double-blind placebo-controlled trial of palmitoylethanolamide (Levagen+) supplementation for seasonal allergic rhinitis symptoms.

items.title: A double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of acupuncture for the treatment of childhood persistent allergic rhinitis.
items.summary: Double-blind RCT comparing active acupuncture with sham acupuncture for persistent allergic rhinitis in children.

items.title: Effects of bepotastine, a nonsedating H1-antihistamine, for the treatment of persistent cough and allergic rhinitis: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
items.summary: Randomized placebo-controlled trial of bepotastine for persistent cough and allergic rhinitis using validated cough outcomes.

items.title: A Comparative Study of Montelukast and Azelastine add on Therapy in Moderate to Severe Allergic Rhinitis Treatment: A Double-Blind Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: Double-blind RCT comparing montelukast and azelastine add-on therapy with intranasal corticosteroids in moderate to severe allergic rhinitis.

items.title: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled crossover study of efficacy of pollen blocker cream for perennial allergic rhinitis.
items.summary: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled crossover study of pollen blocker cream for perennial allergic rhinitis.

items.title: New progress in pediatric allergic rhinitis.
items.summary: Comprehensive review of recent research on etiology, diagnostic classification, treatment methods, and health management of allergic rhinitis in children.

items.title: Current Management of Allergic Rhinitis.
items.journal: The journal of allergy and clinical immunology. In practice
items.summary: Current management guidelines for allergic rhinitis including pharmacological treatments, nonpharmacological options, and allergen immunotherapy.

items.title: Allergic Rhinitis: Mechanisms and Treatment.
items.journal: Immunology and allergy clinics of North America
items.summary: Review of allergic rhinitis mechanisms, prevalence, economic burden, and comprehensive treatment approaches with focus on individualized care.

items.title: Comorbid allergic rhinitis and asthma: important clinical considerations.
items.summary: Expert review of pathophysiological and clinical links between allergic rhinitis and asthma, with focus on treatment considerations for comorbid patients.

redFlags: Monitor for comorbid asthma development in allergic rhinitis patients
Consider comprehensive evaluation for indoor and outdoor allergen sensitivities

excludedAgents.reason: Failed to show efficacy in double-blind placebo-controlled trial for seasonal allergic rhinitis symptoms

excludedAgents.name: Acupuncture
excludedAgents.reason: Active acupuncture showed no significant difference compared to sham acupuncture in treating persistent allergic rhinitis in children

excludedAgents.name: Pollen blocker cream
